Thirsty Thursdays Slow Roll

West Hartford, CT · Social

Thirsty Thursdays Slow Roll is a social group ride in West Hartford, CT. It rolls third Thursday of the month at 6:30 pm from Asylum Ave and the Trout Brook Trail.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: slow roll. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Thirsty Thursdays Slow Roll group ride

A monthly slow roll along the Trout Brook Trail that picks people up along the way and ends at GastroPark for the social hour. Run by the town's bike-walk-transit advocacy group. Any bike, any pace.
